strengths: Search-to-Booking Conversion Model project is essentially the JD's headline Look-to-Book problem: LightGBM on price/availability/session features, evaluated with ranking metrics and a simulated A/B test, scheduled in Airflow and served via FastAPI
Gradient boosting (LightGBM/XGBoost), classification and regression shown in production context across multiple roles
SQL and PySpark pipeline work shown at scale (500+ devices, large healthcare datasets)
Business-problem framing explicit, matching the JD's 'translate business objectives into ML tasks' ask
gaps: Entity matching and RecSys/ranking depth (KNN, FAISS, Learning-to-Rank, pointwise/pairwise/listwise) - an explicit JD must-have - is entirely absent
No terabyte-scale big-data evidence specific to travel/B2B pricing
No prior TravelTech, e-commerce or B2B API domain experience outside the one fit project
Embedding-based matching mentioned only briefly, not framed as entity matching
